title: When the Veil Sings Revisited
author: Ulyana Eriksen
blurb: Ansel Ravensworth, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
